entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system. This AGPL-3.0 context database demonstrates a 91% reduction in token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships to manage information. It features gap analysis to identify missing query data and supports multi-tenant deployments with scoped data access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a high-scale engine supporting 100B+ tokens per month with sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It combines RAG with automated fact extraction and offers native connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or dedicated Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It serves as the upstream library for Hermes persistence wrappers and supports managed, local, or Docker Compose deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It achieves sub-linear storage growth through episodic compression and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to provide structured facts, vector search, and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like traces and context bundles. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to store messages. It utilizes a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata, allowing agents to search and expand compacted summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It imports data from sources like Obsidian and GitHub, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy for long-term recall.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores human-readable engrams in YAML format on local disks for multi-agent systems. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings to retrieve context via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes Agent through MCP and hooks, employing a hybrid retrieval system of BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It includes native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recall result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn offers cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local SQLite-vec cache. It functions as an MCP-native server and was developed as a Hermes 2026 Hackathon entry.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, aiming to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It operates as a local-first system or MCP server using a SQLite-backed vault for governed retrieval.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search and ranked graph traversal with edge tags for bidirectional relationships. It features automated indexing for diverse sources including codebases, URLs, and multimedia via OCR.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking for tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent context. It features a 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during prefetch and employs BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer provides a deterministic lifecycle kernel for hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for importing documents and includes an opt-in catalog for documenting external tool integrations.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a transparent audit trail of every memory operation through a trace.jsonl log file.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes agents using a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox. The plugin facilitates pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain state across interactions.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle HTTP 402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains. It allows agents to pay for APIs and settle transactions directly to wallets with zero fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to improve agent routing. It includes five native tools for searching and fetching knowledge, with support for automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of stored memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods with MinHash deduplication for robust data management.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private local code memory by connecting Hermes to a local SourceVault server for indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands for repository search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation tool uses a git-backed directory of markdown files to manage memory without a traditional database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators that propose evidence-cited diffs to resolve stale or conflicting information.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously through a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to enforce rigorous software development standards.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables design and prototyping via 26 different CLI executables, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It allows agents to iterate on live designs in a sandboxed iframe and export finished artifacts to formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. By combining vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning, it allows agents to perform complex searches using Python, Rust, or TypeScript clients.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 different diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure the accuracy of converted Mermaid text.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It integrates a master router with verification and dispute resolution layers to manage secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a specialized two-pass detection system. It supports multiple modes including rewrite and edit-in-place, with optional voice profiles for technical or professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution by allowing agents to merge and cross-pollinate capabilities across platforms like Hermes and OpenClaw. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the evolution of agentic skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and Codex. It maintains session state within a project's documentation directory to ensure continuity across agent interactions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code for professional and life tasks. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for popular tools like Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants Hermes Agent and other coding tools the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract video transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key to facilitate data extraction from the platform.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose new, reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical prompts and thinking instructions tailored to specific domains. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots identified through pre-built analytical lenses.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support instructions, resources, and scripts via programmatic skills and remote registries. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency while ensuring type-safe interactions.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes to accommodate different project complexities.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into synchronized documents. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically reflects source code edits back into the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes a mechanism kernel to operate without a background service. It organizes agent activity through four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—requiring Herdr for hosting Supervisor rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on stored work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts using the Agent Skills specification. It provides specialized support for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and services like CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX models for image and video generation, including specialized modules for cinematic inserts and product ads. The project provides API integration, prompt optimization, and audio directing capabilities.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with full audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers a CLI and Python client for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It supports the AgentSkills specification and incorporates commerce features through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a local-first workflow language that audits AI operations for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run, providing a secure and verifiable execution environment for Hermes workflows.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including semantic embeddings and RRF fusion, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It optimizes token efficiency and supports graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows Hermes agents to manage system design via the Model Context Protocol while the user executes tasks.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that employs three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and edge cases without modifying code. It combines deterministic scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI and Discord, to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent skill that uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. it supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A comprehensive cybersecurity lab providing over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven security tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management and multi-session reconciliation to maintain memory across agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial code reviews while offering tools for worktree recovery and state drift detection.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate demo GIFs for repository READMEs. It ensures all rendered files are optimized under 8 MB and embedded directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to prevent rot. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It integrates with clients like Hermes and Cursor to provide direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement feedback loop that analyzes session history to propose skill coverage updates. It gates all modifications behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and agents like Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the functional quality of agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and environment-specific Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures file operations use the correct syntax for the detected runtime without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments via x402.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides tools for video-to-text conversion, document OCR, and agent memory management compatible with Hermes Agent standards. It supports cross-platform use on macOS, Linux, and Windows for various e-commerce and text processing tasks.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with agents such as Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It integrates tools from various providers like Google and OpenAI into a reproducible development environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that bundles official Hermes installations with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes a REST API and CLI for managing per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, reboot-safe deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers using systemd. It configures the Hermes Gateway for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to power specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It includes a dedicated Portfolio Manager to handle final transaction approval and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Designed for self-hosted orchestration, this tool governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface to manage persistent coding agent sessions via tmux. It supports multi-repo workspace management and sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and can detect HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales from single agents to automated teams via a task bus pattern. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform allows users to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It features a Kanban board for task tracking, live streaming of agent reasoning, and human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Built on Hermes Agent profiles, this web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing project structures. It automatically synchronizes the index on every file change and supports multiple languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based dashboard and web visualization tool designed to track token usage across various AI coding agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It allows developers to monitor consumption metrics and submit data to public profiles or leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other AI providers build better user interfaces. It integrates directly with markdown-supporting agents to provide structured UI development assistance.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It features multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It provides control over visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to reverse recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities and automatic context recall for frameworks and chat bots on platforms like Telegram and Slack. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents, allowing for specialized skills and custom instructions within specific directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins, offering a zero-cost path to a production-ready environment.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts to flag overlapping tool descriptions or inconsistent schemas. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks, utilizing HERM v1.1 scoring for validation.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles the setup of systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It operates entirely offline across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro, requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup is a local-first skill designed to help users generate revenue using dynamic slash commands and a deterministic local runtime. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or writes performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It centralizes the management of Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with 21 professional assistants specialized in creating PPT, Word, and Excel documents. It facilitates remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent by providing guided installation and provider setup. The application includes a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages five agent runtimes and unified configurations across 10 platforms, including Discord and Slack. It enables the creation of visual workflows with approval gates and provides tool traces and file previews.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager for comprehensive agent oversight.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime for site-aware drafting in 31 environments. It features live browser control that requires explicit approval gates for agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server via HTTPS or Tailscale to support real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Operating locally on macOS 14+ without telemetry, this cockpit tracks live session quota burn by model, tokens, or cost. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for 15 different agent sources.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a kanban board for agentic work and task management. It allows users to manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets through a terminal-based chat environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to validate Telegram sessions.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to operate. It connects to both cloud and local AI models and features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a dedicated file browser for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration settings. It allows for full review of conversation histories and skill source code while tracking session activity and costs.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers. It uses isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate for different workflows.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents via a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store containing over 50 curated one-click installations for expanding agent capabilities.
